title: Involving before Evolving: A Vision for Trustworthy Enterprise Digital Twin Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2609.13071v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprise Digital Twins (EDTs) promise data-driven decision support at organizational scale, but realizing them requires navigating siloed departments, tacit knowledge, and high-stakes decisions with long-horizon consequences. Existing approaches involve domain experts during model development but focus less on early organizational buy-in in EDTs. We present a vision for trustworthy EDT engineering grounded in an `involving before evolving' paradigm: rapidly involving stakeholders through a working prototype before evolving toward federation and full interoperability. Our three-stage approach combines foundation models for rapid prototyping, an ontological backbone for federated interoperability, and observability tooling for stakeholder trust. We ground our vision in an ongoing collaboration with Michelin, a multinational manufacturer, where an initial prototype has helped support stakeholder buy-in.

translated_title: 先参与后演进：可信企业数字孪生工程的愿景
translated_abstract: 企业数字孪生有望在组织规模上提供数据驱动的决策支持，但实现它需要应对部门孤岛、隐性知识以及具有长期影响的高风险决策。现有方法在模型开发过程中让领域专家参与，但较少关注企业数字孪生早期的组织认同问题。我们提出了一个基于“先参与后演进”范式的可信企业数字孪生工程愿景：先通过一个可运行的原型快速让利益相关者参与进来，再向联邦化和完全互操作性演进。我们的三阶段方法结合了用于快速原型设计的基础模型、用于联邦互操作性的本体骨干，以及用于建立利益相关者信任的可观测性工具。我们将该愿景建立在与跨国制造商米其林持续开展的合作中，一个初始原型已帮助获得了利益相关者的认同。
tldr: 该论文提出“先参与后演进”的可信企业数字孪生工程愿景，通过可运行原型快速建立利益相关者认同，再结合基础模型、本体骨干和可观测性工具实现联邦互操作性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a vision for trustworthy Enterprise Digital Twin engineering based on an "involving before evolving" paradigm, using a working prototype to rapidly secure stakeholder buy-in before evolving toward federated interoperability with foundation models, an ontological backbone, and observability tooling.
